decisions.reason: The custom in-ear earmold draws directly on the firm's core earmold, hearing-system and digital production knowledge, so it can interpret results and refine it, though its limited web presence leaves some risk of it being merged into other offers.
The individual EARsleeve has its own page and sits at the heart of the firm's otoplastic expertise, letting it absorb fitter feedback and keep improving the product.
The vacuum thermoforming unit extends the firm's long-established dental equipment and materials system, where in-house R&D supports continued integration and improvement.

The orthopedic shoe last is distant from the firm's core, which limits its ability to interpret results, but it rests on transferable digital-manufacturing and custom-fit know-how and has its own page, so the firm will likely give it more time.
The post-curing unit complements the firm's 3D-printing resins and dental workflow, building closely on existing materials and device knowledge.
